{{Quote|Yes, disaster was averted. But is a hair's breadth a comfortable margin in which to risk the outcome of the war? Factor in the recent loss of the ''Negotiator''&mdash;an entire flagship destroyed while rescuing truant Jedi children in a sector far from the frontlines, we are left with an unescapable conclusion.|[[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], in a [[Reformation of Jedi military command|memorandum]] to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="Facebook" />}}
The '''''Negotiator''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that served as a [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224 "Cody"]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was also [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Block/Legends|Block]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].

==Description==
The ''Negotiator'' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy's]] [[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle Fleet]]. It was equipped with a [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanism]]. It carried [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] such as [[Clone Z-95 starfighter/Legends|Clone Z-95 starfighters]] and [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] or [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|LAAT]] gunships.<ref name="BFR" />

==History==
The ''Negotiator'' saw service in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Block/Legends|Block]]. It was adorned with three red markings on each "wing" surface and wore the symbol of the [[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle Fleet]].<ref name="CSWE" /> It served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]],<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rising ''Malevolence''">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode002.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref> who had earned the nickname "[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|The Negotiator]]."

===Battle of Christophsis===
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the ''Negotiator'' was sent to break [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench's]] blockade around [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] and rescue [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] who was trapped on the planet. During the time, a [[Stealth ship/Legends|Stealth ship]] was loaded in the hangar. When the ''Negotiator'' arrived, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] ordered [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to fall back to a position behind [[Christophsis's moon/Legends|Christophsis's moon]]. Kenobi then devised a plan where Skywalker would deliver supplies to Senator Organa using the stealth ship. The situation quickly soured as Trench ordered a bombing of Organa's position, forcing Skywalker to go on the offensive. The Jedi were able to break the Separatist blockade and deliver supplies to the battered Republic military on Christophsis.<ref name="CM">{{TCW|Cat and Mouse}}</ref>

===Hunting the Malevolence===
[[File:VenatorTurbolasers-SoM.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Negotiator'', ''Resolute'', and another Star Destroyer firing all batteries on the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]]]
The ''Negotiator'' joined the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] and another Republic star destroyer against the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] in the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] and succeeded in further damaging the already-crippled warship. However, when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] captured Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] aboard the ''Malevolence'', Kenobi and Skywalker went aboard to rescue her, and also succeeded in reprogramming the ship's [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]] to fly into the [[Dead Moon of Antar/Legends|nearby moon]].<ref name="SOM" /><ref name="DM">{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}}</ref>

===First Battle of Felucia===
[[File:BlockadeofFelucia.png|thumb|290px|The blockade of Felucia]]
Later during the [[First Battle of Felucia/Legends|First Battle of Felucia]], the ''Negotiator'' was present alongside two other Star Destroyers, the ship was under the overall command of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]]. After breaking the Separatists blockade, [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] led [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]] and [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] towards the planet surface to evacuate the republic forces on the planet. Later, the republic forces withdrawn from [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].<ref name="HH">{{TCW|Holocron Heist}}</ref>

===Destruction===
{{Quote|This is General Kenobi. Abandon ship. Abandon ship!''"<br />"''Sir, shouldn't we stay and fight? We can't lose the ship now!''"<br />"''Cody, this ship is already lost. We must face it. You and I are going to give Grievous a little ''parting gift''.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Cody, deciding to activate the ''Negotiator''{{'s}} self-destruct sequence|<ref name="BFR" />}}
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Death Sentence 1" /> the ''Negotiator'' was damaged and boarded when General Grievous launched an [[Attack on Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet/Legends|assault]] on Kenobi's fleet. It was eventually destroyed through its self-destruct mechanism that was activated just before General Grievous' boarding party overran the ship.<ref name="BFR" /> Kenobi later transferred his forces to another ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer.<ref name="A Necessary Bond">{{TCW|A Necessary Bond}}</ref>

[[File:NegotiatorDestroyed-BFR.png|thumb|left|300px|The destroyed ''Negotiator'']]
The destruction of this ship, as well as the [[Carida Incident]] later on that similarly resulted in the self destruction of a ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer due to Separatist machinations, this time the ''[[Renown/Legends|Renown]]'', was later cited by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] in a [[Reformation of Jedi military command|memorandum]] to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in order to persuade him to gradually phase out the Jedi, fearing that their continued command over the Republic Forces would force the Republic to lose the war to the Separatists.<ref name="Facebook">{{Facebook|username=StarWarsTheCloneWars|url=photo.php?fbid=494382640601035|name=''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''|date=2013-01-15|archivefile=File:Memo.jpg}}</ref>

==Commanders and crew==
The ''Negotiatior'' was the flagship of Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi.<ref name="SOM" /> At one point, it was commanded by Admiral Block.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Following ''Negotiator''{{'s}} [[July 26]], [[2008]] debut in ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]''[[Clone Wars (PocketModels)|'': Clone Wars'']],<ref name="SWPMTCG:CW">{{PocketModel|set=Clone Wars|unit=''Negotiator''|ship=''Venator''-class star destroyer|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipcw23.jpg}}</ref> it appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television]] episode "[[Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence'']]," which aired on [[October 3]], [[2008]], following the premiere of "[[Ambush]]" on [[Cartoon Network]].<ref name="RS" />
